content.title: Kawaii Pop Stage | Heart Graphics, Candy Orbit and Dance Lockup
content.summary: An adult pop host summons hearts, letters and candy rings before a clean POP SIGNAL lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult character and wardrobe remain stable. + Every graphic family follows a visible body gesture. + Exact words remain readable and do not cover the face for long. + Prop counts escalate in controlled stages. + The final flash follows a centered full-body lockup and exact title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult animated pop host with blue hair and a mint-lilac hoodie on a glossy dark stage with sparse glass shapes. Push to the face as the exact letters POP enter behind her; she winks once and keeps the same hair clips. Hold the host at center while bubbles double in count, then end on one clean white flash carrying the exact title POP SIGNAL.

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.

invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Exact words remain readable and do not cover the face for long."

invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Prop counts escalate in controlled stages."

invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final flash follows a centered full-body lockup and exact title."
